learning_outcomes.text: Design of mobile applications using Kotlin language in Android Studio

syllabus_topics: Maps and location, gsm, wifi, gps
assessment_rules: Grades are given based on a percentage: A 90%, B 80%, C 70%, D 60%, E 50%. The assessment is 100% based on exercises (30%) and homeworks (70%). There is no final exam.
bibliography: Neil Smyth: Android Studio 4.0 Development Essentials - Kotlin Edition, 2020
Bruce Eckel & Svetlana Isakova: Atomic Kotlin, 2021
institution: Univerzita Komenského v Bratislave (Comenius University Bratislava)
degree: Bachelor Applied Informatics (1-AIN), Faculty of Mathematics, Physics and Informatics
